name: The Ninth Circle

description.content: Each time you [Taunt] a [Terrified] Survivor for the first time, gain a Token, up to [4].
When the Exit Gates are powered, if you have [4] Tokens, the [Bag of Toys]' cooldown is reduced to [1s].

quote: "Sadistic, creepy, and shockingly gory. What kind of person would be interested in this?"
